prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Game sprite sheet of MOSCARDINI, the boy in bottom row of attached reference; ONLY that boy, not Bianca. Preserve design exactly: short bulky shaggy dark brown side-swept hair with pointed tufts and large locks over forehead, warm light-medium skin as original, dark eyes, smile, white Brazilian school raglan t-shirt with bright green sleeves and collar and tiny green square left chest badge, long very dark teal trousers, black/white sneakers. Compact chibi pixel-art RPG student; retain exact hairstyle, silhouette, colors and clothing; no beard, glasses or new accessories. Create precisely 8 separate whole-body WALKING sprites in4columns x2rows regular sheet, real transparent background, no text/grid/shadows/floor. TOP ROW four distinct walking stages facing SOUTH/front toward viewer: left-foot contact, passing, right-foot contact, opposite passing. BOTTOM ROW four walking stages facing WEST, profile toward LEFT EDGE. Match actual orientation geometry, original labels on profiles are reversed. Every pose is whole and complete with head/arms/legs. Keep head/body scale fixed, feet at same baseline, spacing and padding10percent. Arms swing opposite legs and feet must alternate; no static duplicates. Source can be high-res, runtime equivalent64x64 per logical cell. Crisp hard-edged pixel art with square clusters and restrained palette matching exact reference. Don't copy labels or background from the reference.
